summary: Frontend-only verification of Prompt 11 partial: contextual welcome message (time/season/first-name) + IA douce preference center. Tested Particulier (membre1.demo) and Bureau (association) accounts. All 4 requested scenarios pass.
critical_code_review_comments: WelcomeMessage: iaWelcomeEnabled() is read only at render time and not reactive to storage changes; toggling the switch in the same tab does not hide/show the banner until navigation/reload. This is acceptable per current spec (reload keeps behavior) but worth noting.
The IA preferences are persisted only in localStorage (per-device), not server-side per-user. If cross-device sync is desired later, migrate to /account/settings.
test_credentials: Particulier: membre1.demo@lavoixduchien.fr / Demo2026! ; Bureau: associationlavoixduchien@gmail.com / VoixDuChien2026!
context_for_next_testing_agent: Particulier welcome banner rendered as 'Bonjour Sophie — Aux couleurs de l'automne, la patience apprise avec Nikko [DEMO], vous l'offrez aussi aux autres.' correctly using first_name+greeting+season+library phrase. In /my-space -> 'Notifications & compte' tab, IA card (account-ia-card) with 3 switches was visible; all defaulted ON. Toggling welcome OFF set localStorage vdc_ia_welcome='off' and after reload the welcome-message was ABSENT (count=0) on /member/dashboard. Toggling ON restored it (count=1). Suggest and Relance switches also persist to vdc_ia_suggest/vdc_ia_relance. Bureau /admin/dashboard shows admin-welcome-message with the same contextual pattern (Bonjour Bureau — Aux couleurs de l'automne, ...). No runtime console errors beyond expected 401/403 pre-auth resource fetches.
